en_US.title: Pavel Sorn Procedure Hold
en_US.scanner: Pavel Sorn is not the villain in the room. He is the room learning how to obey until obedience kills it.
en_US.field_note: Useful evil often signs in normal handwriting.
en_US.terminal: SORN, P. Local contract office holds evacuation release pending external certification. Worker distress acknowledged. Atlas continuity seal unresolved. Follow procedure until channel clears.
en_US.audio: He wrote the sentence that kept the door closed and probably hated it less than he should have.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Pavel Sorn gives the crime an ordinary operator. His procedure holds show how Deep Reach can be guilty without every human participant being a mastermind: obedience, delay and clause discipline become lethal.
en_US.external_site: Pavel Sorn Procedure Hold is the bureaucratic horror packet: a local contract officer follows procedure too long, converting a real geophysical disaster into a fatal corporate permission problem.

ru_RU.title: Процедурная задержка Павла Сорна
